scripts.test: pnpm -C packages/triad-engine test && pnpm -C apps/web test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C packages/triad-engine build && pnpm -C apps/web typecheck
scripts.build:web: pnpm -C packages/triad-engine build && pnpm -C apps/web build
scripts.release:check: pnpm -C packages/triad-engine lint && pnpm -C packages/triad-engine build && pnpm -C apps/web typecheck && pnpm -C apps/web lint && pnpm -C apps/web build
scripts.handoff:check: pnpm codex:doctor && pnpm lint:motion && pnpm release:check
